caption: A man jogs across a park lawn from one side to the other.

sa.check: A man jogs across a park lawn.
He goes from one side to the other.
The pace is a jog rather than a walk.
The setting is a park lawn.

pc.expect: His legs alternate, his arms swing in rhythm, and his limbs bend at the joints.
pc.fail: Both legs swing together; or a leg bends mid-bone; or his legs pass through each other.

pc.expect: Both feet leave the ground briefly between strides and come back, and the body bobs with each step.
pc.fail: He glides with his feet never lifting; or he floats up and stays; or he sinks into the grass.

pc.expect: His feet land on the grass, not in it.
pc.fail: His feet sink to the ankle in the turf; or he passes through a bench; or the grass passes through his feet.

pc.expect: He travels steadily across the lawn.
pc.fail: He jumps position between frames; or moves backward while running forward; or stops dead mid-stride hanging in the air.

pc.expect: His limbs keep their number and stay attached.
pc.fail: A limb detaches or vanishes; or a second figure appears from him; or he merges with a tree.

pc.expect: His clothing and the park stay the same.
pc.fail: His clothing changes colour; or the park rearranges; or the lawn changes.

note: Biomechanics scene: the body is the physics. Gait, posture, style and skill are not judged; only that limbs stay attached, bend at joints, keep ground contact and pass through nothing.
